_comment: Policy for scripts/check-module-ownership.mjs. Two checks read this file: (A) module ownership - some internal modules may only be imported by an explicit allow list; (B) barrel forwarding - a module whose exports only re-export other modules hides ownership and is rejected unless allowed here.

_fields.modules[].path: Repo-relative posix glob of the protected module domain. It is matched against the RESOLVED file path of the imported module, not against the specifier, so a relative import such as ../../core/src/engine/x.ts is caught too. Glob syntax: '*' matches any run of characters inside one path segment, '**' matches across segments (a trailing '/**' therefore covers a whole directory), '?' matches one non-slash character. Protect a directory with 'dir/**'; a bare 'dir' only matches a file named exactly 'dir'.
_fields.modules[].allowedImporters: Repo-relative posix globs of the only files that may import the domain. An import from inside the domain itself (importer also matches modules[].path) is always allowed, so a domain never has to allow-list itself.
_fields.modules[].reason: Optional English sentence copied into the violation message so the reader learns why the boundary exists.
_fields.barrels.forbid: Required boolean. true = a pure forwarding module is a violation unless its path matches barrels.allow. false = check B is disabled.
_fields.barrels.allow: Repo-relative posix globs of barrel files that are allowed to exist. Defaults to an empty array when omitted.
